Alternative: use cd into Reports then mv summary.doc .? But summary.doc is in parent. We can cd Reports, then mv ../summary.doc .? But mv cannot use path. So maybe we need to use cp then rm. But cp also cannot use path. So maybe we need to use cp summary.doc Reports/summary.doc? But path not allowed. So maybe we need to use cp summary.doc Reports? That would copy into directory Reports. But cp expects destination name; if destination is a directory, source will be copied into this directory. So we can cp summary.doc Reports. That will copy into Reports. Then rm summary.doc. Let's do that.
